name: Scandinavian Modern
description: Light-filled minimalism with warm organic woods, airy off-white walls, and natural sage textiles.
designerTips: Pair blonde oak dining and coffee tables with curved spindle chairs.
Use woven wool rugs and open-grain timber shelving for warmth.
Incorporate soft 2700K ambient illumination and organic linen drapery.

matchingSets.living: Light Oak media console + Off-white linen sofa + Sage green throw cushions
matchingSets.dining: Solid oak dining table + Molded oak dining chairs with matte black legs
matchingSets.bedroom: Natural oak platform bed + Flanking oak nightstands + Oatmeal cotton duvet

name: Industrial Loft
description: Bold metropolitan aesthetic featuring reclaimed dark walnut, exposed concrete flooring, and cognac leather.
designerTips: Contrast raw blackened steel frames with weathered, character-rich timber.
Choose distressed top-grain cognac leather for primary lounge seating.
Install directional track lights and exposed filament fixtures to create dramatic highlights.

matchingSets.living: Distressed cognac leather sofa + Dark walnut coffee table with steel legs
matchingSets.dining: Reclaimed wood slab dining table + Matte black metal industrial chairs
matchingSets.bedroom: Black iron pipe bed frame + Reclaimed walnut nightstands + Charcoal linen bedding

name: Minimalist Sanctuary
description: Purity of line and volume: seamless bleached ash, architectural white planes, and brushed satin aluminum.
designerTips: Keep floor planes completely uncluttered to highlight spatial rhythm.
Favor handleless push-to-open cabinetry to preserve uninterrupted geometric planes.
Emphasize negative space around central walkways and breathing zones.

matchingSets.living: Low-profile ivory fabric sofa + Monolithic bleached ash block coffee table
matchingSets.dining: Seamless matte white lacquered table + Minimalist molded shell chairs
matchingSets.bedroom: Floating low-slung ash bedframe + Recessed LED backlighting + Crisp white percale

name: Japandi Warmth
description: The seamless fusion of Scandinavian functionality and timeless Japanese organic balance.
designerTips: Incorporate low-profile furniture to celebrate vertical headspace and calm.
Introduce handcrafted ceramic accessories and woven rattan accents.
Diffuse incoming daylight through sheer rice-paper texture screens.

matchingSets.living: Low wooden frame sofa with oatmeal cushions + Round smoked cedar coffee table
matchingSets.dining: Curved bamboo edge dining table + Woven paper cord dining chairs
matchingSets.bedroom: Tatami-inspired smoked timber platform bed + Terracotta washed linen duvet
